tps_reset_confirm: Reset all Third Person options to their defaults?
tps_start_in_tps_desc: Start each session in third person view. Off: start in first person. The hotkey switches live either way.
tps_keep_hud_in_ads: Keep crosshair and motion dot while aiming
tps_keep_hud_in_ads_desc: In third person the game would hide the crosshair and the motion dot while aiming down sights. On: they stay visible. Off: vanilla behavior.
tps_switch_time_desc: How long the camera glides when switching between first and third person.
tps_side_desc: Camera offset to the right (cm). Negative = left shoulder.
tps_ads_dist_desc: Camera distance behind your head while aiming down sights (cm).
tps_ads_side_desc: Camera offset to the right while aiming (cm). Negative = left shoulder.
tps_ads_up_desc: Camera height above your head while aiming (cm).
